calmResponses: I hear you, and I want you to know — what you're feeling right now is completely valid. 💛 You don't have to carry this alone. Take a slow, deep breath with me. In… and out. You are safe here. Whenever you're ready, share as much or as little as you'd like.

Thank you for trusting me with this. That takes real courage. 🌸 Before anything else — how are you feeling right now, in this moment? Your emotional wellbeing matters most. I'm here to listen without judgment, and to gently guide you through your options.

You reached out, and that matters more than you know. 💙 Sometimes just putting words to what we're going through is the first step toward healing. I'm here with you. Let's take this one step at a time — there's no rush. You are not alone in this.

I'm so glad you're here. What you're going through sounds really difficult, and your feelings make complete sense. 🤍 Please be gentle with yourself right now. You deserve support, safety, and care — and that's exactly what we're here for.

It's okay to feel overwhelmed. It's okay to feel scared. Those feelings are your mind's way of saying this matters. 🌿 I'm here to sit with you in this, help you feel grounded, and then — when you're ready — look at what steps might help.
groundingPrompts: Can you name 3 things you can see around you right now? This can help bring you back to the present moment. 🌱
Take a moment to place both feet flat on the floor. Feel the ground beneath you. You are here. You are safe. 💛
Try this with me: breathe in for 4 counts, hold for 4, breathe out for 4. You've got this. 🌬️
chat.welcomeMessage:
Hi {name} 💛 I'm really glad you're here.

This is your safe space — a place where you can share what's on your mind without fear of judgment. Whether you're feeling anxious, overwhelmed, scared, or just need someone to talk to, I'm here for you.

I'm here to:
• 🌸 Listen and support you emotionally
• 🧘 Help you feel calm and grounded
• 🛡️ Guide you through your rights if needed

Take your time. What's going on for you today?
chat.clearWelcome: Fresh start, {name}. 💛 I'm still right here with you. Whenever you're ready, share what's on your mind — there's no rush, no pressure. This is your space.
